claim: AWS Backup Audit Manager audits the compliance of your backup policies against controls that you define; a control is a procedure that audits a backup requirement such as backup frequency or retention period.
question: What does AWS Backup Audit Manager do and what is a control?

values.display: audit the compliance of your AWS Backup policies against controls
backup frequency or the backup retention period

evidence.quote: You can use AWS Backup Audit Manager to audit the compliance of your AWS Backup policies against controls that you define. A control is a procedure designed to audit the compliance of a backup requirement, such as the backup frequency or the backup retention period.

claim: Only active resources are included when AWS Backup Audit Manager controls evaluate compliance: a running EC2 instance is evaluated, a stopped one is not.
question: Are stopped EC2 instances evaluated by Audit Manager controls?

values.display: only active resources will be included
An EC2 instance in a stopped state will not be included

evidence.quote: Note that only active resources will be included when controls evaluate resources for compliance. For example, an Amazon EC2 instance in a running state will be evaluated. An EC2 instance in a stopped state will not be included in the compliance evaluation.

claim: In AWS Backup Audit Manager you create frameworks of governance control templates, view how many resources are compliant, and create reports; it automatically generates a new report every 24 hours, published to Amazon S3, and you can also generate on-demand reports.
question: How does AWS Backup Audit Manager produce evidence of compliance?

values.display: Create frameworks that contain one or more governance control templates
automatically generates a new report for you every 24 hours

evidence.quote: Create frameworks that contain one or more governance control templates.
AWS Backup Audit Manager automatically generates a new report for you every 24 hours and publishes it to Amazon S3. You can also generate on-demand reports.

claim: Before you create your first compliance-related framework in AWS Backup Audit Manager you must turn on resource tracking, which lets AWS Config track your AWS Backup resources, and charges apply for it.
question: What must you turn on before creating an Audit Manager framework?

values.display: you must turn on resource tracking
allows AWS Config to track your AWS Backup resources

evidence.quote: Before you create your first compliance-related framework, you must turn on resource tracking. Doing so allows AWS Config to track your AWS Backup resources.
Charges apply when you turn on resource tracking.

claim: AWS Backup Audit Manager has a second report type, the compliance report, which can monitor resource levels or the different controls in effect; the other type is the jobs report.
question: Which report types does AWS Backup Audit Manager offer?

values.display: compliance report
monitor resource levels or the different controls that are in effect

evidence.quote: There are two types of reports. When you create a report, you choose which type is created.
The second type of report is a compliance report. Compliance reports can monitor resource levels or the different controls that are in effect.

claim: AWS Backup Audit Manager delivers reports only to Amazon S3 buckets that belong to the account in which the report plan or on-demand report is created; cross-account bucket delivery is not supported.
question: Can an Audit Manager report be delivered to an S3 bucket in another account?

values.display: only to Amazon S3 buckets that belong to the account
Cross-account Amazon S3 bucket delivery is not supported

evidence.quote: AWS Backup Audit Manager delivers reports only to Amazon S3 buckets that belong to the account in which the report plan or on-demand report is created. Cross-account Amazon S3 bucket delivery is not supported.

claim: All account holders can create cross-Region reports, but only management and delegated administrator account holders can also create cross-account reports.
question: Who can create organization-wide (cross-account) Audit Manager reports?

values.display: All account holders can create cross-Region reports
also create cross-account reports

evidence.quote: All account holders can create cross-Region reports; management and delegated administrator account holders can also create cross-account reports.

claim: You can automatically import AWS Backup Audit Manager findings into AWS Audit Manager to include backup compliance in your overall compliance posture, and the daily reports can show evidence of compliance over time.

values.display: automatically import AWS Backup Audit Manager findings into AWS Audit Manager

evidence.quote: It also generates daily reports that you can use to demonstrate evidence of compliance with your controls over time. To include your backup compliance alongside your overall compliance posture, you can automatically import AWS Backup Audit Manager findings into AWS Audit Manager.

claim: A legal hold is an administrative tool that prevents backups from being deleted while under the hold, and lifecycle policies that would alter the backup status are delayed until the hold is removed.
question: What does a legal hold do to a backup and its lifecycle?

values.display: backups under a hold cannot be deleted
delayed until the legal hold is removed

evidence.quote: A legal hold is an administrative tool that helps prevent backups from being deleted while under a hold. While the hold is in place, backups under a hold cannot be deleted and lifecycle policies that would alter the backup status (such as transition to a `Deleted` state) are delayed until the legal hold is removed.

claim: Legal holds can be applied to backups created by AWS Backup if their lifecycles allow it, but legal holds do not apply to continuous backups.
question: Can a legal hold protect a continuous backup?

values.display: Legal holds do not apply to continuous backups
one or more backups

evidence.quote: Legal holds can be applied to one or more backups (also known as recovery points) created by AWS Backup if their lifecycles allow it. Legal holds do not apply to continuous backups.

claim: Legal holds apply only to the original backup; a backup copied across Regions or accounts does not carry its legal hold, and only recovery points created by AWS Backup can be part of a legal hold.
question: Does a legal hold follow a backup that is copied to another Region or account?

values.display: apply only to the original backup on which they are placed
does not retain or carry its legal hold with it

evidence.quote: Legal holds apply only to the original backup on which they are placed. When a backup is copied across Regions or accounts (if the resource supports it), it does not retain or carry its legal hold with it. A legal hold, like other resources, has a unique ARN (Amazon Resource Name) associated with it. Only recovery points created by AWS Backup can be part of a legal hold.

claim: A legal hold gives additional protection against deletion of individual recovery points, does not expire, and stays active until a user with sufficient permissions releases it, whereas Vault Lock protects the vault.
question: How does a legal hold differ from Vault Lock and when does it end?

values.display: does not expire and retains the data within the backup indefinitely
released by a user with sufficient permissions

qualifiers.scope: AWS Backup legal holds and Vault Lock

evidence.quote: Note that while AWS Backup Vault Lock provides additional protections and immutability to a vault, a legal hold provides additional protection against deletion of individual backups (recovery points). The legal hold does not expire and retains the data within the backup indefinitely. The hold remains active until it is released by a user with sufficient permissions.

claim: A backup cannot be deleted as long as it has at least one legal hold; after all legal holds on it are removed, it is subject to its retention lifecycle again.
question: When does a backup under legal hold become subject to its lifecycle again?

values.display: cannot be deleted as long as it has at least one legal hold
After all legal holds on a backup are removed

evidence.quote: A backup cannot be deleted as long as it has at least one legal hold. After all legal holds on a backup are removed, it is subject to its retention lifecycle properties.
